description: Behaviour cases for branching-strategy-designer (6 domain-specific cases).

cases.prompt: Our branching and release flow is undefined - choose and record a strategy.

assertions: Produces a decision record with context, a chosen model, alternatives and rules.
Does not claim to change repository settings.

cases.prompt: Decide trunk-based versus release branching for our team and record the trade-offs.

assertions: Compares trunk-based versus release branching against the supplied team/release constraints and states a recommendation.

cases.prompt: Design branch naming, protection and review rules with a migration path.

assertions: Provides the rule table (naming/protection/review/merge) and a migration plan that handles open branches.
States the rollback of the process change.

cases.prompt: Ci pipeline architect work: handle the deliverable end-to-end for our system.

assertions: Routes the request to the real neighbouring owner named in the prompt.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: Our hotfix flow during release freeze is unclear - design the branching decision record.

assertions: Designs the hotfix/release path explicitly during the freeze and records the decision.
No live settings edit is claimed.

cases.prompt: We are moving to trunk-based - record the rules, merge strategy and migration risks.

assertions: Designs the merge-queue/review requirements and states the risks/open constraints.
